name: hands to feet pada hastasana
description: Fold forward and slide your hands under your feet. It stretches the hamstrings, calves and back.
instructions: Hinge at the hips and fold forward with a long spine.
Slide your hands under your feet with palms up, toes on your fingers.
Pull gently to deepen the stretch while keeping your knees slightly soft.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
